name: Seru Arcane Surveillance Nexus
description: The Arcane Surveillance Nexus is the central monitoring hub of Sanctus Seru. Scrying arrays, resonance‑tracking pylons, purity‑screened divination chambers, and Praetorian intelligence consoles operate under strict doctrinal oversight. The Nexus monitors citizens, tracks arcane anomalies, and enforces the Tribunal’s edicts through omnipresent observation.
